name: @fl03/harness-pi
description: Pi coding agent adapter: consumes @fl03/compiler's `pi` emission target (~/.pi/agent/prompts/*.md slash commands, ~/.pi/agent/skills/, and a jiti-loaded TypeScript extension implementing the guard layer as pi.on('tool_call', ...)). The only adapter that re-interprets the shared predicate spec in TypeScript rather than shelling out to the Rust engine, since Pi has no native hook module. Implemented in Wave 4 (W4-S6); this is the workspace skeleton only.
